title: Line-item grid: a multi-value lookup column shows "undefined" in read-only and list mode (the read-only LookupField is not told the field is multiple)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Found by the #36552 dev (PR #36616), outside that card. Reproduced on main by the dev. Not claimed. Related: #36552.

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:ui`

## What happens

In the line-item grid, a lookup column whose field is `multiple` shows the text "undefined" in read-only mode and in list mode. The editable cell shows it correctly ("2 selected").

## Why

The read-only `LookupField` is rendered in two places without the field's `multiple` flag, so it reads a list of ids as one id.

## Ask

Pass `multiple` (from the field definition, not a guess at the value's shape) at both read-only sites, so a multi-value lookup shows the same summary as the editable cell, with a test per site.

## Re-check

A line-item grid with a multi-value lookup column, viewed read-only: the cell shows the selected titles or count, never "undefined", when fixed.
